baseline-final.label: baseline-final
baseline-final.method: Fresh Edge; frozen offline Summer 1 view; fixed green primary/white secondary paint (fresh PolyTrack profiles randomize paint); shared camera via POLYSHADE_CAMERA_FILE. Full preset settings including clouds and motion blur. Three seconds warmup, ten seconds sampling per case; 60 Hz presentation cap. Cloud time is fixed only for paired captures. Diagnostic timestamps sampled asynchronously every 12 frames.
